The '''Ghost of Jhonterius Park''', who claimed to be the spirit of [[Jhonterius]], was a mysterious, dark-robed figure who appeared in [[Jhonterius Park]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He claimed to have come from beyond death to save the city of [[D'larah]] from its impending doom, which many believed referred to the impending [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] that would destroy the [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system]]. He refused extended communication with others, mostly frightening them away with wails. All attempts by the [[D'larah City Patrol]] to arrest him failed. A small [[Jhonterius worshippers|cult]] formed around the figure, made of those who believed he was Jhonterius returned.<ref name="TC" />
